title: Scorned Wilderness Skips 1.0.1 (missing Cataclysm Keep skip, just solve it asap)
author: SirRebral
chapters: Air barrier and skip across to Cataclysm Keep
description:
1.0.1 patched a few of the original skips, the most obvious one being the OOB during Cataclysm Keep, there's currently no skip (that I know of) for that area so just solve the puzzle fast with smart pathing.

0:00 Dragontail Vines
0:53 Skip to Fragments of Ghornfell
1:58 Skip across to Stronghold
2:48 Air barrier and skip across to Cataclysm Keep
4:02 Kuldra

The skip to Fragments of Ghornfell I saw in a video by @SectorTSWG 

Jagex have said there will be "Fixes for skips in the Scorned Wilderness Raid." in a coming update soon, so have fun running the raid with skips while you can.

comments.author: @jamescash6235
comments.text: hey, awesome guide. Just a question about the surge + phase dash combo, does it matter what weapon your holding? I noticed sometimes I get further if I start the movement by blocking with sword/shield equipped instead of a staff. might be totally irrelevant so just checking - ive been having trouble making the jump @ 1:22

comments.author: @Sir_Rebral
comments.text:
It doesn't matter what you're holding no, just make sure you have forward momentum by moving before you surge. It can be tricky and until you get the hang of it I recommend using recall and if you miss you can just teleport back

There's also a new out of bounds skip for Cataclysm keep, you can see that in action on iNanobit's run on his channel or SamFPlays
